Selection Expander.js

Hello

this is Tool script to expand selection (poly or edge) by some condition.

* same normal polygons.
* convert selection to border edges from selected polygons. [new!]
* open edges.
* cover edges.

demo (youtube) : http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ov7NRUu0pw8

download( old version. not updated anymore ): http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=48

download for 5.2+: http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=54

update 20120927: new function added. undo/redo supports.

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto
